free_tier.stated: '$1000 Credits' plus 'Discounted Compute Usage for 6 Months' and 1-on-1 engineering support. Its eligibility list is the interesting part, because it ends with a lane for people with no institution: after 'Researchers... From accredited academic or non-profit organizations', 'Faculty Members', and 'Graduate & Postdoctoral Researchers', it lists 'Other Independent Researchers - Anyone conducting their own research projects'. The vendor's own follow-up post repeats the framing: 'If you're an academic or independent researcher working on GPU-intensive AI or data-driven research, we're still actively reviewing applications.'
